description: The active-test-session.tsx component already has a progress bar, navigation grid, per-question timer, and countdown timer implemented. However, the user's requirements specify specific improvements: (1) the progress bar should show current question with a blue highlight segment, (2) the stats line below should show 'X answered . Y flagged . Z bookmarked' format, (3) the countdown timer should be formatted correctly and show per-question timer as display, (4) the navigation grid is already present. Review the current implementation against requirements and ensure all details match the spec exactly: blue highlight on current question segment in progress bar, proper color coding (green=correct, red=wrong, gray=unanswered, blue=current), proper stats format. The component is 593 lines and already has most of the functionality - verify all spec items are met and make any adjustments needed.
steps: Read the current active-test-session.tsx (593 lines) and compare against the user's spec point by point

Progress Bar: Ensure the progress bar shows blue highlight for current question segment (currently it shows gray for unanswered including current). Add distinct blue color for the current question's segment.
Stats line: Format should be 'X answered . Y flagged . Z bookmarked' with dot separators per the spec
Countdown Timer: Already implemented with auto-complete on 0. Verify it shows mm:ss at top-right counting down from timeLimit. Verify per-question timer display.

Navigation Grid: Already implemented with color coding. Verify all color states match spec (green=correct, red=wrong, blue ring=current, gray=unanswered, orange border=flagged, star=bookmarked). In timed mode only forward navigation (already done). In untimed mode any question clickable (already done).
Remove the duplicate progress indicator (the older thin progress bar in the 'Top bar' section that duplicates the new colored progress bar above it)
Ensure mobile responsiveness - grid should wrap properly on small screens
Run npx tsc --noEmit && npm run lint to verify
acceptance_criteria: Progress bar shows green/red/gray/blue segments where blue is the current question
Stats line shows answered count, flagged count, and bookmarked count
Countdown timer displays mm:ss and auto-completes session when reaching 0
Per-question timer displays elapsed time for current question
Navigation grid shows all question numbers with correct color coding
Navigation grid restricts backward navigation in timed mode
No lint errors (npm run lint passes)
